Israeli listings also show both manual and robotic transmissions and multiple trim/version names, so exact trim and transmission remain unresolved. Because the row represents a combined family-level variant rather than one exact Israeli-market variant, it must stay split_required and cannot enter the clean catalog.

validated_variants.grounding_summary: Searches across Israeli automotive portals (Yad2, iCar, Gear, Auto, ynet) confirm that the Abarth 500/595 with a 1.4 Turbo 145 hp engine and manual transmission was officially imported to Israel. It was exclusively marketed under the 'Scorpione' trim. This version was introduced in early 2017 as part of the facelift (often branded as 595 globally but widely listed as 500 in Israel) and was discontinued in November 2022 when it was replaced by the 165 hp 'Nuvolari' trim. The vehicle is a FWD hatchback.
